远程不认这把 SSH 密钥：看看 ssh-agent 里有没有它、公钥加没加到账: The remote doesn't accept this SSH key: check that ssh-agent has it and that the public key is added to your account.

远程仓库不存在，或者没有权限看它。: The remote repository doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
远程仓库本身不受影响；本地的 %d 个远程分支引用（%s/…）会一起删。: The remote repository itself is untouched; the %d local remote-tracking refs (%s/…) go with it.
远程分支名没变，推送时会新建 %s: The remote branch keeps its old name; pushing creates %s
远程分支的本地引用（%d 个）和用到它的上游设置 git 会一起改。: Git also renames its remote-tracking refs (%d) and the upstream settings that use it.
远程有本地没有的提交：先拉取（或变基到远程）再推送。: The remote has commits you don't have locally: pull (or rebase onto the remote) before pushing.
连不上远程：看看网络和地址。: Can't reach the remote: check the network and the URL.
